policy: Install selected capabilities from official origins; resolve current compatible stable versions at setup and record the actual result locally. No third-party implementations are bundled.

ponytail.installation: Follow the current official host plugin or extension instructions; native plugin state requires host verification. Shared foundation guidance is the fallback.

graphify.installation: Use the current supported uv/pipx package installation and host integration instructions at the origin.

rtk.capability: Compact command output with full diagnostic fallback
rtk.installation: Use the current official release or Cargo installation. Verify this is Rust Token Killer before configuring host hooks.

markitdown.installation: Use the supported package installer with only the document extras needed by the project.

openspec.installation: Use the current supported npm package installation from the official documentation.
